summary: 94/42 lists named liturgical chants. The form mo dḥilo occurs inside one title, alongside qadiš and other liturgical expressions; its cited register must be distinguished from productive Turoyo fear predication.
The occurrence cannot resolve experiencer coding, valency, aspect or Detransitive function for ordinary Turoyo. Existing active I fürchten remains unchanged; no idiomatic phrase is added.
Should quoted Syriac hymn titles be indexed separately as liturgical citations? A native Turoyo example is needed before adding a feared/awe-inspiring verbal box.
